name: powerhouse-delivery-self-optimization
purpose: Predict and eliminate preventable delivery failures before they consume CI/deploy cycles, while preserving exact-head safety, protected merge and production proof.
trigger_when: creating or repairing a material repository delivery candidate
a new test is not covered by any workflow
GitHub cancels a job without a concrete failing assertion
multiple terminal candidates touch shared delivery or skill surfaces
a merge/retry/promote decision depends on previously read state
a candidate has not yet proven its post-merge deploy/readback/writeback path
required_behavior: Refresh authoritative main/head/merge-base/mergeability/workflow state before every material delivery transition.
Forecast the next likely invalidation: drift, overlap, hot-surface collision, missing classifier coverage, admission mismatch, scheduler risk, deploy/readback dependency or skill-writeback gap.
Validate PR metadata with the canonical admission parser/policy before expensive CI.
Add workflow/classifier coverage in the same candidate as every executable test.
Preflight machine schema and regression assertions together so contract drift is found before remote CI.
Treat cancelled GitHub jobs without concrete assertions as scheduler recovery and retry only the missing job on the same exact head.
Reconcile moving main on the same lineage while preserving the complete current-main union.
Avoid hot shared skill/policy surfaces when a dedicated projection can carry the same reusable knowledge without changing authority.
Re-read state immediately before irreversible merge/promote actions and re-plan whenever the epoch changes.
Do not create duplicate lineages for ordinary drift; rebuild a bounded current-main successor only when divergence makes reconciliation unsafe or inefficient.
Preflight the terminal path through protected merge, deploy/readback, outcome and learning/skill writeback before starting the mutation.
Measure forecast quality and delivery friction and feed both into future candidate planning.
